title: Integrate chat routing, sandbox, context and RAG updates for v0.7.0
description: Combine automatic chat routing, mandatory execution permissions, managed Docker sandbox, permission-aware RAG and existing local source changes; validate and publish a unified runnable version.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend controls simplified; sandbox and RAG permission regressions covered; backend and frontend checks complete; version committed and pushed; original working directory updated.
close_reason: Integrated and pushed v0.7.0. Validation: 508 backend tests, 5 real Docker tests, 7 frontend tests; types, lint, build, OpenAPI and live API/artifact checks passed. Original working directory runs the integrated version.

title: P3：受控联网、外部工具权限和注入攻击评估
description: 在离线 Docker MVP 上增加受控网络出口与域名策略，按操作审查浏览器和 MCP 能力；补充注入攻击评估集与外发数据审查。默认拒绝未知工具，禁止按模型自报风险授权。

title: Docker-first managed sandbox with explicit E2B backend
description: Implement self-hosted Docker session lifecycle, bounded execution and artifacts, trusted tool authorization, reviewed host writes, E2B opt-in adapter, deployment documentation and real container security tests.
close_reason: Implemented Docker-first execution, ownership and single-use permissions, bounded artifacts and reviewed writes, lifecycle cleanup, explicit E2B adapter, chat controls and deployment documentation. Verified 414 backend tests including real Docker, frontend build/tests and SDK.

title: 简化聊天模式入口并接入自动路由
description: 仅保留 Deep Research 开关，删除 Web/Agent/MCP 入口及快捷问题隐式模式；普通请求通过 autoRoute 进入 SmartRouter。前端实现、测试与构建已完成，完整后端387通过/3跳过/1已知基线失败。待交付：当前账号没有 origin 写权限，保持既有推送目标。

title: 实现 P0–P2 本地智能体安全边界
description: 实现提示词信任边界、默认拒绝的工具权限网关、macOS Docker 离线沙箱、一次性审阅写回、审计和回归测试。仅个人本地单进程使用；保留 provider 和 principal 扩展点。
notes: P0–P2 实现完成：安全测试45通过，Docker2通过，全后端373通过/3跳过/1已确认基线失败（weaver-ptr），前端类型、2测试、构建通过。交付暂阻：origin skygazer42/Weaver 对当前 SSH/GitHub 账号只有读权限；等待确认 fork 或切换可写账号。

title: Add Docker Chromium and authenticated preview ports
description: Follow-up to the completed Docker execution core: design network and origin restrictions, authenticated per-session preview proxy, Chromium/VNC streaming, and isolation tests before exposing browser/web-server capabilities.

title: 修复 SSE 排队事件与 50ms 取消窗口的竞态
description: 未改动基线也复现 tests/test_chat_sse_quality_events.py::test_stream_flushes_queued_quality_update_before_graph_completion 失败。主循环每 50ms 轮询队列，而测试在 50ms 取消。后续改用事件驱动唤醒，验证 queued quality_update 能在 graph 完成前立即发出。

title: P4：多人身份、角色与安全状态生命周期
description: 增加可信登录身份、角色策略、多工作进程会话协调、审批与审计数据保留/删除、运维监控；当前本地配对令牌和单进程锁不作为多人隔离方案。

title: Validate optional E2B adapter against a live disposable account
description: Docker is fully verified locally. E2B has SDK contract tests without using cloud quota; run a live owned-account smoke for create/execute/files/timeout/recovery and record template and plan limits before a cloud production rollout.
